newsitem.title: USA: Scotsman has 94 pct of Kysor.
newsitem.headline: Scotsman has 94 pct of Kysor.

text.p: A subsidiary of Scotsman Industries Inc has accepted about 94 percent of Kysor Industrial Corp's stock under a tender offer for all common and preferred shares at $43 each, the companies said Monday.
About 5.6 million shares of Kysor common and 760,000 shares of Kysor preferred were tendered, representing about 94 percent of all outstanding Kysor shares, the companies said.

They said all conditions related to completion of the transaction have been satisfied, including the sale of substantially all of the assets of Kysor's Transportation Products Group to a subsidiary of Kuhlman Corp. That sale is is expected to close today.
The Scotsman subsidiary is expected to be merged into Kysor, with each share of Kysor not purchased in the tender offer being converted into the right to receive $43 cash.
The merger is expected to be completed on or about March 12, the companies said in a joint statement.
Scotsman and Kysor signed a definitive merger agreement on February 2.
Scotsman makes refrigeration products, including ice machines, beverage dispensing systems, food preparation and storage equipment, and related products.
Kysor's Commercial Products Group makes refrigerated display cases, commercial refrigeration systems, and insulated panels for the supermarket and foodservice industries.
